title: Beginner Nail Class
shortDescription: A practical foundation course for aspiring nail techs who want to build confidence and technical skill.
description: A practical foundation course for aspiring nail techs who want to build confidence and technical skill.
overview: This beginner course introduces the essentials of nail preparation, hygiene, product handling, and client-ready finishing. It is designed for students who are starting from scratch or building a more structured foundation. By the end of the course, students should be able to prepare the natural nail correctly, apply a clean basic set, and understand the core workflow used in a salon environment.
requirements: No formal prior nail experience is required.
A basic study routine and time for practical repetition are recommended.
Students should have access to a clean workstation and a basic beginner kit for practice.
learningOutcomes: Identify the structure of the natural nail and explain why preparation matters.
Follow a hygiene-first service workflow before product application.
Prepare the nail plate, cuticle area, and surrounding skin with control.
Apply and finish a beginner-level set with consistent shape and balance.
Spot common beginner mistakes and correct them during practice.

materials.summary: A simple workflow for completing a full beginner set with clear checkpoints.

faq.question: Who is this course for?
faq.answer: This course is designed for students who are new to nail work or want a clearer foundation before moving into more advanced technique.

faq.question: Do I need prior experience?
faq.answer: No prior formal experience is required. The course starts with the basics of prep, hygiene, and application.

faq.question: What materials do I need?
faq.answer: A basic starter kit, clean workstation, and the products listed in the course materials section are recommended for practice.

faq.question: How long does the course take?
faq.answer: The beginner class is planned over four weeks with structured lessons and practical checkpoints.
